category: apparent dark matter, dark energy, gravity and observational baselines
caution: Explanatory targets are observed effective gravitational and cosmological phenomena. Inclusion does NOT declare particle dark matter or dark energy nonexistent. Many candidate models posit dark particles, fields or fluids. None validated as emergent pre-spacetime ontology.

entries.mechanism: modified inertial/gravitational response below empirical acceleration a0
entries.effects_targeted: apparent galaxy mass discrepancy; tight RAR
entries.potential_caustep_bridge: effective acceleration law; challenge mechanism to derive rather than insert a0
entries.missing_inputs_and_countertests: nonrelativistic relation alone misses CMB/lensing clusters

entries.mechanism: relativistic scalar and vector fields with MOND quasistatic and CDM-like linear regimes
entries.effects_targeted: galaxy kinematics and CMB linear matter spectra without conventional cold DM
entries.potential_caustep_bridge: cross-scale consistency target (galaxy to CMB) with explicit action/dynamical variables
entries.missing_inputs_and_countertests: requires Lorentzian metric and scalar/vector fields; nonlinear cluster/lensing and stability not fully settled

entries.mechanism: metric, vector, scalar field modification matching MOND lensing
entries.effects_targeted: apparent mass and gravitational lensing in relativistic galaxy models
entries.potential_caustep_bridge: what a relativistic completion of galaxy phenomenology needs
entries.missing_inputs_and_countertests: fields/metrics are postulated; nonlinear cosmology and galaxy clusters challenging

entries.mechanism: de Sitter entropy volume response and matter-displacement elastic interpretation
entries.effects_targeted: additional apparent galaxy-scale gravitational attraction without particle DM
entries.missing_inputs_and_countertests: assumes de Sitter background/baryonic matter, current H0, effective entropy law; radial acceleration tension and no complete relativistic cosmology
